title: UPDATE : Street Fighter Champion Edition HD
author: Fantastic-Jeweler781
selftext:
Made with Claude mostly (part with Chatgpt due Images and the usage limites), is not a version of the game, but a program that works as a layer on top the original ROM, It's not quite finished yet. There are still a few minor bugs to fix, but my version of **Street Fighter Champion Edition HD** is about 90% complete.

What makes this version different is that **it plays exactly like the original game, down to the smallest detail**, because it runs directly on the original game's ROM. This means it preserves all the original mechanics, quirks, glitches, and tricks.

I know that games like *Super Street Fighter II Turbo HD Remix* and *Ultra Street Fighter II* already exist, but there's a reason I'm making my own version.

I'm part of a community of competitive Street Fighter players, and for purists like us, those newer versions just don't play the same. Even the slightest changes to the original mechanics can completely alter how the game feels.

**My goal is to bring the original Street Fighter experience into HD without changing what makes it feel and play exactly like the original but with a facelift.**
